rules.sentence: Brucellosis is a zoonosis whose occurrence and control are closely related to its prevalence in domesticated animals.
The true global 194e-1 prevalence of human brucellosis is unknown because of the imprecision of diagnosis and the inadequacy of reporting and surveillance systems in many countries.

In Europe, the incidence of brucellosis in a country is inversely related to gross domestic product, and, in both developed and less well-resourced settings, human brucellosis is related to rural poverty and inadequate access to medical care.

Failure of veterinary control programs due to conflict or for economic reasons contributes further to the emergence and re-emergence of disease, as seen currently in some eastern Mediterranean countries.
